requirements.requirement: The system must ingest credential, license, and taxonomy fields from the NPI data payload provided by provider_detail_service.py.
The system must compute a completeness score using the weighting logic defined in EVAL-CRED-001.
The system must normalize the final completeness score to the defined range (0–1 or 0–100) per the scoring contract.
The system must generate a component-level breakdown showing individual scores for credentials, licenses, and taxonomy fields.
The system must treat null or missing credential fields as zero contribution to the completeness score.
The system must handle multiple taxonomy entries by evaluating presence and counting at least one valid taxonomy as contributing positively to completeness.
The system must handle empty taxonomy arrays without throwing errors and assign zero contribution for taxonomy completeness.
The system must treat multiple credential or license entries as valid and not double-count beyond the defined weighting cap.
The system must produce deterministic scoring results for identical input payloads.
The system must return the completeness score and breakdown in a structured, serializable response object.
The system must handle malformed or unexpected NPI field structures gracefully without runtime failure.
The system must assign a completeness score of zero when all credential, license, and taxonomy fields are missing or null.
The system must assign a maximum completeness score when all required credential, license, and taxonomy fields are present and valid.
The system must ensure that partial data (e.g., only credential present) results in a proportional score based on defined weights.
